entries.back_en: I didn't know what to think when I received the news from Ludia that you'd been captured.
What should I think? My daughter goes out in search of her missing sister, and is captured invading enemy territory... How did this happen?
I beg your forgiveness, Majesty. It's my fault. If it weren't for me...
As you probably discovered, our neighbor and supposed ally Ludia cares more about its relations with the Empire than about helping me search for my daughter.
So, what do you intend to do now? Sooner or later, the Ludians will discover you are here. We will, of course, do everything we can to protect you...
I see... But... Although I'm king of Wyndia, I have no control over the dragon... You know that.
entries.note: 'Eu vejo' is literal mistranslation of 'I see'; should be 'Entendo'.

entries.back_en: Hmmm... I see... Very well. Go to the forest east of here. There you'll find the Oracle of Wind, a priestess who serves the Wind Dragon.
entries.note: 'Eu vejo' wrong for 'I see'; 'Oracle' left untranslated (Oráculo).

entries.back_en: I'll inform her you're coming. Rest tonight--you can begin your journey in the morning.
The Oracle lives in the forest east of Wyndia. Don't worry--if the Ludians ask about you, we'll think of something to distract them.
The King is in a very difficult position... On one hand, he must protect his daughter, Princess [04]; on the other, he must maintain our relations with Ludia.
I pity the poor King... Although he worries about Princess Elina more than anyone, he doesn't discuss the matter with anyone in public. It hurts to see this...
entries.note: Faithful; 'Dói ver isso' captures 'breaks my heart' adequately.

entries.back_en: The [09][07][05] is an ancient sacred relic, needed to enter the Tower of Wind, which is sacred to the Wind Dragon. It is kept in a safe place beneath the castle.
P'ung Ryong, the Wind Dragon, is unusual among his kind in that he still interacts with mortals and speaks to them from time to time.
We've heard reports that Ludian troops have been seen near the castle. You must hurry, before they find out you're here!
They say the only way to see the Wind Dragon up close is to go higher than the Tower of Wind to the north. But how could anyone do that?
Wait... If Princess [04] and I are joined, that means I will one day be King of Wyndia... Will I be able to handle the responsibility?
If I marry Princess Elina, that means the whole country of Ludia will be after us... Will I be able to protect her from them?
Hmmm... The other half of the First Emperor, you say? Now I understand why both Ludia and the Empire were looking for you! You carry a heavy burden... I wish you the best.
Hmmm... The other half of the First Emperor, you say? Now I understand why both Ludia and the Empire were looking for you! You carry a heavy burden... I wish you the best.
[04]... There is little I can do for you now. You've grown much, my daughter. You're strong enough to fight your own battles now. I'm very proud of you!
I know what His Majesty the King said, but I also know that in his heart he still worries about you, Princess. Take care, and return home soon!
Princess Elina still hasn't returned... I only pray nothing happens to Princess [04]...!
If I marry Princess [04], all of this... The town, the people... All of it will be mine! Ha ha... Bwah ha ha ha ha!
Why, Princess [04]! For a moment I almost mistook you for your sister. You've grown much more like her in recent weeks--more confident, more mature. If only she were here to see you now!
Ha ha... Bwah ha ha ha! Look at the poor wretches down there! They're like ants! Insects! Bwah ha ha ha ha!
entries.note: Adds 'pobres coitados' (poor wretches) not in source 'the people'.
